id: title:DanielVisca:reduce logs transformation per record latency

review.posthog_relevance: Ingestion-worker performance and memory safety; bounded LRU cache for RE2 prevents unbounded memory growth from customer-controlled regex patterns, while the missing implementation of the shared record-building and transformation globals prevents a definitive score of 3.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability: P1.F2.H1 adds a bounded LRU cache for RE2 instances, explicitly rejecting oversized patterns and g/y flags to prevent unbounded memory growth, which is a critical reliability improvement for ingestion workers. P1.F10.H2 and P1.F9.H1 introduce production-path micro-benchmarks and record-building optimizations that could lower
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the complete implementation of the shared, reusable record-building and transformation globals, and the complete execution of the transformation service, preventing a definitive score of 3. P1.F10.H6 only shows a state flag change without full dependency context. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single grouped change. No adoption, incident, or benefit is inferred. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a bounded LRU cache for RE2 instances keyed by pattern and flags; rejects oversized patterns and g/y flags; uses JSON.stringify key and LRU eviction.
observations.posthog_connection: Ingestion-worker regex reuse; shared memory bounded by entry count and per-entry size; avoids unbounded growth from customer-controlled patterns.

observations.behavior: Adds tests for the RE2 cache: identity, pattern distinction, flag distinction, no-cache for oversized, cache at boundary.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the cache implementation and its bounds behave as documented; no benefit inferred, only implementation and checks.

observations.behavior: Adds decodeLogAttributeValue and encodeLogAttributeValue; decode uses JSON.parse, encode uses JSON.stringify; no longer uses parseJSON wrapper.
observations.posthog_connection: Attribute-value ingestion and transformation; removes the instrumented parseJSON wrapper to reduce per-record overhead; no benefit inferred, only implementation and checks.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the shared, reusable `buildLogRecordGlobalsRecord` and `refreshLogRecordGlobalsRecord` functions, nor the complete `encodeAttributeMap` and `applyTransformResult` bodies. The chunk also lacks the complete `executeLogTransformation` and `LogsTransformerService` implementations, and the complete `compileHog` and `executeLog`/

observations.behavior: Adds a production-path micro-benchmark and its test assertions, including a 500µs per-record ceiling and 200-iteration mean check.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether the per-record transformation path stays under a performance ceiling; this could help catch regressions in HogVM or the transformation pipeline.

observations.behavior: Adds a new `buildLogRecordGlobalsRecord` and `refreshLogRecordGlobalsRecord` to extract and refresh the record half of globals, and an `encodeAttributeMap` that accepts decoded originals to avoid redundant decoding.
observations.posthog_connection: These could reduce redundant attribute decoding and re-encoding, potentially lowering per-record latency, but the chunk does not show the complete implementation or the complete `executeLogTransformation` and `LogsTransformerService` implementations, so the benefit is not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F10.H6 is supplied. No score assigned. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds recordDirty = true after incrementing the succeeded counter.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk resides in the LogsTransformerService, which processes ingestion and transformation records. Setting recordDirty likely marks the record as requiring further processing or re-evaluation, potentially affecting downstream state or triggering a refresh, though the exact dependency is not shown in this hunk.
